service.description: inbox-source: an app that keeps the user's messages beyond mail answers the Inbox's operations (org.moqui.comms.InboxServices.run#Operation names them: get#InboxData, find#InboxRows, get#ThreadView, send#Compose, get#CommsHome and the others) with handled true and result, the operation's out-parameters, for parameters, its in-parameters; its answer is the whole answer, its page the list. handled false leaves an operation to the framework. operation accounts answers the app's own accounts (accountList, the Internal account).

recipient-source: people, groups and lists with addresses for a text (recipientList), each {itemId (unique in the source), kind, name, and its addresses; for kinds phone (the Dialer, V3), phoneList [{number in E.164, label}]}, at most limit, the source's own page (recipientListCount, its total). Authority is the signed-in user's.

parameter.name: kinds
parameter.description: A comma list of person, group, list and phone (recipients with phone numbers); empty for all

service.description: record-lookup, by operation (org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.lookup#Records combines the answers): info (records [{recordEntityName, recordId}]: recordList of {recordEntityName, recordId, entity, visible, title, typeLabel, url, icon}), card (recordEntityName, recordId: card, as m-record-card shows it), search (text: optionList of {value: entity|id, label}) and links (body: recordList of {entity, id}, the records a message's links name). A record the user may not see is answered visible false, or not at all.
record-link: link a message (emailMessageId) or a chat event (chatRoomId, eventSeq) to a record; answers the link (recordUrl).
create-from: make a record of kind from a message or a chat event; answers its url (recordUrl).
invitation: answer the calendar invitation a message carries (accept, tentative or decline).
contact-card: a card for an address or a number (card), with an add-to-contacts action when there is no contact yet.
meetings-source: the user's meetings in a range, each with its call link (meetingList).

call-context: who a caller is and their open records, for a screen pop (V5: the ring bar and m-call, CallServices.get#CallContext, as the user rung). number is E.164. Answers contactList (each {name, kind: person or organization, url, detail}) and recordList (each {title, status, url}), at most 10 and 20, only what the user may see.
home-source: the Comms Home cards it adds (cardList, each with its rows and a link to more).
external-conversation: file a bridged conversation on a record; retried with idempotencyKey, which must not file it twice. Answers the link (recordUrl).
